title: Microsoft 365 outage, Nov 12-13, 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Microsoft, any government agency, news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: Exchange Online email is a service many organizations and governments rely on every day. Microsoft says most users were affected for about 24 hours, and problems were reported in at least 70 countries. This is actual impact, not potential.
who_is_affected: Most Microsoft 365 business, school and government users who rely on Exchange Online or Outlook for email. This was a service outage, not a breach. Be wary of emails about the outage that ask you to click to restore held messages.

known.text: Exchange Online and Outlook were down for most users from 11:20 AM ET Nov 12 to 11:10 AM ET Nov 13, per Microsoft's report.
Most users could not reach their mailboxes, and parts of Teams, Copilot, SharePoint and OneDrive were also affected.
Microsoft's preliminary report blames a latent defect from a July update, set off by extra traffic and reduced capacity. This is Microsoft's own finding.

not_known.text: What Microsoft's final post-incident report will add. It is due Nov 20, 2026.
Exactly how many users and organizations were affected.
Why the safeguards between regions failed. Microsoft says only that "a separate issue" let the failure spread.
Whether the phishing campaign stole any credentials. Microsoft says this has not been confirmed.
